_: THE DATA-OUT CONNECTORS (V3-DATA-MODEL 2.12, P5). Every output SecurityInsight writes through an output map (data-model/outputs/<id>.locked.json) is listed here as a connector: the connector name its runs are recorded under (cfg.ConnectorRun, and each item it wrote, changed or stopped sending with its values before and now in cfg.ConnectorChange -- Configuration > Connectors > Runs), what kind of destination it is, and whether it is on when nothing is chosen. An output map without an entry here fails a test (no hidden connector). 'writtenBy': the output is written by another registered connector, which keeps its own column contract ('fixedColumns': the columns are the target table's -- a customer cannot change them). 'editions': where the writer runs. 'default': on when the setting SI_DataOut_Outputs is empty; 'defaultEditions': the editions where it is on when that setting is empty although 'default' is false (every Excel output is off by default in Pro and can be switched on; the Community edition keeps its CI workbook). 'step': where it is written -- 'ci-build' (the CI build writes it, in both editions) or, when absent, the data-out step at the end of the data sync. Read by engine/data-out/SI-DataOut.ps1 and the web app (embedded copy, held to this file by a test).
